UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again
UNAUTHORIZED: Session expired. Reopen the app from the bot
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute
BIKE_TAKEN: This bike is already booked for these dates
INVALID_TRANSITION: This action isn't available for the booking in its current status
MIN_RENT_DAYS: The rental is shorter than the minimum. Add more days
LEAD_TIME: Too soon: we need more lead time before the start. Pick a later time
AGREEMENT_REQUIRED: You need to agree to the rental rules
PHONE_REQUIRED: Enter a phone number so we can reach you
HOLD_EXPIRED: The booking hold has expired. Please book again
PAYMENT_NOT_AVAILABLE: Payment isn’t available for this booking
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERROR: The payment service didn’t respond. Try again in a minute
CONSENT_REQUIRED: You need to consent to personal data processing
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Upload a file up to 10 MB
INCIDENT_NOT_AVAILABLE: Not available now: this booking is no longer waiting for handover.
INCIDENT_NOT_OPEN: This case is already resolved. Refresh the screen.
INCIDENT_WAIT: The location can still respond. Full-refund cancellation opens a little later.
BIKE_MISSING_TOO_EARLY: You can report this closer to the pickup time.
REPLACEMENT_UNAVAILABLE: This bike is already taken. Choose another option.
INCIDENT_OPEN: The customer reported the bike is missing. Resolve that first: another bike, a replacement or cancel with a full refund.
BIKE_MISSING_CLOSED: The location is closed now. Contact them when it opens.
TEST_PAYMENT_RESTRICTED: Test payment is only for staff and testers.
DOCUMENT_LIMIT: Document limit reached. Delete old ones in your profile and upload again.
TOO_MANY_BOOKINGS: Too many active bookings. Pay for or cancel one of them.
DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED: Upload photos of your passport and licence first.
LICENSE_REQUIRED: Without a licence you can only rent bikes up to 50 cc. Select your category and upload your licence, or choose another bike.
